name: caltrack
description: Log food in CalTrack by telling Claude what you ate.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to your CalTrack data folder on this PC. Claude can read your menu and any day's log, log foods from your menu or one-offs you describe, and add foods and recipes to your menu from USDA FoodData Central. Your data stays in the folder. USDA lookups are made by the CalTrack app with the key saved in its Settings, so CalTrack must be open for those.

tools.name: list_menu_items
tools.description: List the foods on your menu with per-serving nutrition.

tools.name: get_day
tools.description: Show what's logged for a day, with totals.

tools.name: log_food
tools.description: Log servings of a food on your menu.

tools.name: log_adhoc
tools.description: Log a one-off food with nutrition you give.

tools.name: search_usda
tools.description: Search USDA FoodData Central (through the open CalTrack app).

tools.name: add_menu_item
tools.description: Add a food to your menu, with USDA's numbers or yours.

tools.name: add_recipe
tools.description: Add a recipe made of USDA ingredients or ones you give.

data_dir.title: CalTrack data folder
data_dir.description: The folder connected in CalTrack: Settings, Data folder.

trace_protocol.title: Record protocol traffic
trace_protocol.description: Save every message between Claude and CalTrack in the mcp-trace folder inside your data folder, for troubleshooting. The files include what you log.
